Title: Admins may see stale data in the Copilot Health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins may see stale data in the Copilot Health page in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

More info: Specifically, monthly data in the Update channels, Microsoft 365 updates (Past 6 months view), Connected experiences status, and OneDrive status cards on the Copilot Health page may not reflect data after July 2026. The Today view in the Microsoft 365 updates card isn't affected.

Current status: We've confirmed that impact associated with CP1482212 persists as the data was not processed as expected. We're validating that the data is present to be able to run the pipeline successfully and remediate impact completely.

Scope of impact: Some admins attempting to see the latest Copilot Health data in the Microsoft 365 admin center may be impacted.

Start time: Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 4:05 PM UTC

Root cause: An upstream process responsible for Copilot Health data was disabled, resulting in the impact.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 12:00 PM UTC
